_doc: Story 9.2 ANONYMIZED LOVABLE FIXTURE — file-metadata business shape. Preserves the file-link METADATA shape 9.3 compares: fileLinks with ownerType/ownerId/purpose/fileName/mimeType — link/type/purpose metadata ONLY. NEVER a raw file blob / base64 / binary payload (R-901/AC1 raw-file prohibition — a fixture that smuggled a customer file would be a full privacy breach). ownerType/purpose values are drawn from the real Phase A polymorphic file_links union (owner_type ∈ customer/facility/contact/calculation/quote_version/quote_acceptance/job; purpose ∈ calculation_attachment/quote_attachment_snapshot/quote_pdf/acceptance_evidence/job_evidence/crm_document). ZERO PII (synthetic file names, no customer identity). Cases are origin:new-expected.

cases.note: File-link metadata for several active owner types + purposes — a CRM document, a calculation attachment, a quote PDF, and an acceptance-evidence reference. Link/type/purpose metadata ONLY (no blob). Preserves the polymorphic file_links shape 9.3 compares.
